data.gender_notes: Haalimah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Haalimah means a guide or helper. This name has a spiritual significance in Islam as it is derived from the Quranic verse, 'And We have sent you (O Muhammad) as a guide and a helper with the permission of Allah.' (35:24). The name Haalimah carries the meaning “Guide, helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Haalimah usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing guidance and support in one's spiritual journey
data.etymology: Haalimah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haalimah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Haalimah is a beautiful and meaningful one in Islamic culture. It is often given to girls as it signifies the hope that they will grow up to be compassionate and supportive individuals who guide and help others. This name is also reminiscent of the influential role that Muslim women have historically played as support systems and caregivers for their families and communities.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual sense, Haalimah is a reminder of the role that every believer is expected to play in the world according to Islam. As the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) was sent as a guide and helper, the believer too has a responsibility to guide and help others towards righteousness. This name is a daily reminder for the bearer to strive in her personal spiritual growth, while also being of service and support to others in her community. Additionally, the name Haalimah signifies connection to Allah, the ultimate Guide and Helper, who is always there to guide and support His believers.
